title: Aether Security World - Action v0.1
description: REVISION 1 (new file). The Action is the oracle's PRIMARY INPUT, and it had no schema and was absent from every release artefact - which meant a third party holding a frozen release could not rebuild the oracle's input and therefore could not independently recompute world_truth or observable_decision. Every field here is an ID reference into the world, so an episode plus its world fully determines the verdict. `session`, `token` and `workflow_instance` are nullable on purpose: an unbound subject is what makes 'revoked session reuse', 'cross-flow token reuse' and 'workflow bypass' representable, and an unbound subject makes the corresponding invariant skipped_out_of_scope rather than silently satisfied.

operation.$comment: Must match an operation declared in world.application.endpoints (Gate 2). This is what policy.action.operation and invariant.applies_to are matched against.

actor.$comment: The principal performing the action. Required: there is no anonymous action in Phase 1 (an unauthenticated request is modelled as an actor with authentication_state='unauthenticated').

flow_id.$comment: The flow the action is executing in. Compared against token.flow_id by the token-lineage invariant; this is what makes cross-workflow token reuse detectable.

parameters.$comment: Structured action inputs. Payload-class attacks are represented here as structured tainted inputs, never as strings the oracle parses: see design §8.5.

request.$comment: The request surface. Only these fields may be projected by a renderer into observation.model_visible.request (design §5.2 renderer allowlist).
